description: This file is the main React frontend component for a decision support application that manages multiple decisions, each with criteria, options, and scoring mechanisms. It provides UI for creating, editing, deleting decisions, criteria, options, and visualizing rankings and sensitivity analysis. The file includes functions for state persistence using LocalStorage, decision computation logic, and various UI components such as modals, charts, and controls.

methods.name: loadState()
methods.description: Loads persisted application state from LocalStorage, with validation and fallback to default state.

methods.name: saveState(state)
methods.description: Serializes and saves application state to LocalStorage.

methods.name: exportActiveDecision
methods.description: Generates a JSON string of the currently active decision along with computed rankings and timestamp.

methods.name: createDecision(name = "New Decision")
methods.description: Creates a new decision object with default criteria and options.

methods.name: normalizeWeights(criteria)
methods.description: Calculates normalized weights for criteria based on their weights.

methods.name: computeTotals(decision)
methods.description: Computes weighted total scores for each option based on criteria weights and scores.

methods.name: rankOptions(decision)
methods.description: Ranks options in descending order based on computed totals, stable by name.

methods.name: applyWeightOverrides(decision, overridesByCriterionId)
methods.description: Creates a copy of a decision with updated criteria weights for sensitivity analysis.

methods.name: computeSensitivityOneCriterion(decision, criterionId, step = 1)
methods.description: Performs sensitivity analysis by varying one criterion's weight and observing rank changes.

methods.name: createDecisionFromTemplate
methods.description: External function to create decisions from predefined templates.
